question: In Volume 96 you introduced all the main members of the Roger Pirates, and one character in particular you called Nozdon, but he had already been introduced in Blue Deep datebook as Seagull, so now I can only think of him as Seagull... What do I do? Captain Tobbi Ota-kun
answer: Wha.........?! ...ohh~... him? Ahh, heheh. Seagull Guns Nozdon, you mean? Yes, yes. Oh dear... Y...you can call him by whichever name you prefer... or even forget him outright.... It's up to you.
name: Marine Captain Tobbi Ota-kun
